My own experience has sadly not been a positive one. I'm currently 9 months in (copper coil was fitted in Jan) and each month I've experienced severe cramping, heavy bleeding and I'm starting to think my anxiety is linked, too.
Today, as I write this, I am learning to accept my ‘sometimes-depressed’ state and know that it is okay to feel sad sometimes. It’s okay to not be okay.
There is also ‘unhappy face’. Unhappy face is a faltering smile. It’s watery eyes on the brink of tears. It’s being in a public place and not looking up for fear of being found out.

I was lucky to have a supportive family. Not once did they tell me to ‘pull myself together’ or show any kind of embarrassment as a result of my public panic attacks and breakdowns. Instead, they talked to me, asked me questions, gave me a hug.

I hadn’t sought help before this point, yet I believe I’ve experienced bouts of depression since my teens, if not, slightly earlier. It was only after university when I moved back home, applied for Job Seeker's Allowance and struggled to find work, that my symptoms flared up.
